Beta analytics, not an actual grid connection. Straight-line distance to mapped geometry — not a cable route, not a connection length, and no route has been walked. A real connection depends on factors that must be studied: network impedance and fault level, thermal headroom, existing committed connections and queue position, right of way, wayleaves and easements, crossings, terrain, land control and consent. None of those can be inferred from a distance. A mapped substation does not confirm capacity, voltage suitability or acceptance by any network party, and absence from a mapped layer is not absence on the ground.
